curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach gaps for turning into traffic, mindful driving, single focus and removing distractions.
Teach the three kinds of vision, path of travel, line of sight and sharing attention.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Vision and attention cards; contrast cards for vision types and path versus line of sight.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on vision and attention.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach headlight reach, high beams, glare, scanning at night, lenses and following distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Night cards; contrast cards for high beam use and glare.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach slowing before curves, lane position, steady speed inside, and leaving a curve.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Curve cards; contrast card for speed before, in and after.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach roll and yaw, inertia, kinetic energy and friction in curves.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Force cards; contrast card naming each force.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on forces in curves.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach slippery roads, the first rain, snow, tires and chains, icy spots, warming ice and black ice.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Weather cards; contrast cards for first rain and icy spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what causes skids, braking and steering in a skid, and hydroplaning.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Skid and hydroplaning cards; contrast cards for steering and braking in each.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on recovering from skids and hydroplaning.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec13-m01..sec13-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
